subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.iterationBudget` and the `onBeforeToolCallingRound`/`supportsIterationBudget` harness contract as the public opt-in iteration-budget API, including fail-closed behavior for unsupported harnesses?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven, but the remaining choice is the durable config/API shape and upgrade behavior for plugin harnesses, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept after rebase
options.body: Keep the current opt-in config and harness contract, resolve conflicts, and merge with compatibility risk documented for unsupported harnesses.

options.title: Narrow the API
options.body: Keep the core budget behavior but revise the public config names, defaults, or harness capability shape before merge.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers want loop-budget work to wait for a broader agent-runtime safety design.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the current opt-in config and harness contract, resolve conflicts, and merge with compatibility risk documented for unsupported harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the maintainer follow-up commits that finalized the branch’s current behavior and tests.
